basic_details.job_title: APSC Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Assam Public Service Commission (APSC) has released the official Research Assistant Notification 2026 on the official website. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the APSC Research Assistant Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates aged between 21 to 38 years with a qualification of Graduate can apply online for the Research Assistant post from the starting date of the application process to 10 September 2026. The official notification PDF and online application link are available below.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 21 years (as on 01-01-2026) Maximum Age: 38 years (as on 01-01-2026) Age Relaxation: SC/ST: upto 43 years OBC/MOBC: upto 41 years PwBD: 10 years irrespective of SC/ST/OBC and UR Category

qualification.details: Research Assistant under Labour Welfare Department: Minimum qualification of 2nd class Bachelor Degree in Art/ Science/ Commerce from any recognized University. Diploma in Computer Application OR Experience in dealing with subjects of Labour Laws in the Government Department/ Organization OR Degree or Diploma in Labour Laws/Social Works.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for APSC Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for APSC Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 is 10 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Assistant posts in APSC?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Assistant post under the Labour Welfare Department in the Assam Public Service Commission.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for APSC Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 38 years of age as on 01-01-2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a 2nd class Bachelor Degree in Art/ Science/ Commerce from a recognized University, along with relevant computer or labour law experience/diploma.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the APSC Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Assistant post ranges from Rs. 22,000/- to Rs. 97,000/- with a Grade Pay of Rs. 9,400/- (Pay Band - 3).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for APSC Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 297.20 for General, Rs. 197.20 for OBC/MOBC, and Rs. 47.20 for SC/ST/BPL/PwBD categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for APSC Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Screening Examination, a Written Examination, and an Interview Test to assess candidates' suitability.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the APSC Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official APSC Recruitment website https://apscrecruitment.in by completing the One Time Registration and filling out the application form.

faq.question: Q9. When does the online application start for APSC Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The online application process for APSC Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 commences on 11 August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for PwBD candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, PwBD candidates are eligible for a 10-year age relaxation, irrespective of their SC/ST/OBC or UR category.
